parameters.content:
## 1 · Receive & validate
Token auth, required fields, email format and size limits.
Invalid requests are rejected with a clear JSON error before spending on AI.
Duplicates (same email) are answered without re-processing.

## 2 · AI qualification
OpenAI returns a strict JSON schema (score, spam flag, intent, budget, urgency).
Retries 3× with backoff. If AI is down, the lead is kept and routed to manual review.
Thresholds live in env vars, not in the prompt.

## 3 · Persist & respond
Lead stored in PostgreSQL (single source of truth),
then the form gets an immediate 201 response.

## 4 · Route & notify
Hot → Mattermost/Slack alert + email + CRM
Warm / Cold → CRM with stage
Manual review → Ops alert + CRM
Spam → stored only

INSERT INTO leads (request_id, email, full_name, company, website, phone, message, budget, source,
                   score, category, intent, budget_signal, urgency, reasoning, next_action, route, llm_model)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3, NULLIF($4::text, ''), NULLIF($5::text, ''), NULLIF($6::text, ''), $7, NULLIF($8::text, ''), $9,
        NULLIF($10::text, '')::smallint, NULLIF($11::text, ''), NULLIF($12::text, ''), NULLIF($13::text, ''), NULLIF($14::text, ''), $15, $16, $17, NULLIF($18::text, ''))
ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET email = EXCLUDED.email
RETURNING *;
